svg.title: Paired WAF performance on Envoy
svg.desc: Three aligned forest plots compare libmodsecurity with the Coraza Dynamic Module for throughput, CPU per request, and p99 latency across twelve workloads. Points show paired medians and lines show the observed range across three runs. Values to the right of one favor libmodsecurity.

g.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Native libmodsecurity HTTP filter relative to the Coraza Dynamic Module
Point = median paired ratio; line = observed min–max across 3 order-rotated process runs. Ranges are not confidence intervals.
Linux x86_64 · Envoy 1.39.0 · OWASP CRS v4.28.0 · 1 Envoy worker · opt, unstripped, ThinLTO, instrumentation PGO
